prompts.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a polished Chinese educational comparison infographic for an existing Teach Pro 学途智伴 competition PowerPoint deck. Wide landscape aspect ratio around 2.3:1, high resolution, exceptionally clear accurate Simplified Chinese typography. Flat editorial information design with small tasteful illustrations of chat bubbles, a Skill folder, a course webpage and saved learning files. Unified palette dark navy #102A43, teal #087F70, pale mint #E1F1EA, warm off-white #FAF7EF. No photos, no laptops, no decorative filler, no logos. No outer title or slide number because the slide supplies them. Top area small scene text exactly: “今天：给我讲 Python 列表。” and “明天：继续教我 Python。” Below, a neatly aligned comparison matrix with three columns and four rows. Headers exactly: “学习环节” | “单次问答式学习” | “学途智伴的课程闭环”. Row 1 exactly: “学习起点” | “目标和基础随提问补充” | “先访谈，再评估起点”. Row 2 exactly: “学习过程” | “讲解、练习与疑问分散” | “课程网页集中学习与作答”. Row 3 exactly: “接续学习” | “换会话后重新交代进度” | “读取本地学情，安排下一课”. Use generous readable row heights and strong aligned typography. A small meaningful closing flow beneath the matrix exactly: “学习目标 → 课程学习 → 作答记录 → 后续教学”. All text must match precisely. Do not add extra claims, statistics, disclaimers, English paragraphs, watermarks or tiny unreadable labels. Visual should communicate how a Skill connects separate learning interactions into a continuing teaching workflow.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a professionally typeset Simplified Chinese teaching-comparison infographic for the Teach Pro 学途智伴 finals PowerPoint. Wide landscape around 2.3:1, high resolution. Match a warm off-white #FAF7EF background, dark navy #102A43 headings, teal #087F70 emphasis, pale mint #E1F1EA. This is an explanatory hypothetical Python LISTS teaching scenario, NOT mathematics and NOT experiment results. No main slide title, no slide numbers, no charts/statistics, no watermark. Three-column editorial comparison table with generous row heights, very legible accurate Chinese, light elegant lines, small meaningful illustrations of a list index strip, a magnifier on a negative index, and changed exercises. Headers verbatim: “学习表现” | “固定进度课程” | “学途智伴的自适应安排”. Three body rows exactly: row one left “学生 A：熟练掌握列表索引”, center “按统一顺序继续”, right “减少重复解释，进入新目标”; row two left “学生 B：不理解负数索引”, center “按统一顺序继续”, right “补充负数索引图解与练习”; row three left “学生 C：原题会做，换题就错”, center “按统一顺序继续”, right “增加变式题，核对迁移表现”. Keep column alignments and each row's association absolutely clear. Use only these words in the table; do not invent formulas or code. A neat short takeaway below table exactly “同一学习主题，依据表现调整内容、难度与提示”. Put a small readable bottom-right caption exactly “Python 列表 · 教学情境示意”. Make the table central and readable for a projected competition slide, with illustrations supporting comprehension rather than decorative. No red crosses, no simplistic claim that all other AI cannot do this. All quoted text must be rendered accurately.
